# Finite common-sector witnesses for all hundred recorded six-member rungs

Every numerical value uses $K=c_f=1$. The rate columns are rounded witness centers, rather than interval proof endpoints. The actual speed uncertainty and positive-root witness intervals are retained in the per-rung outward-rounded certificates under `.local-data/ring-exploration/stability/`. Each row certifies two distinct simple positive real roots; it does not count the complete complex spectrum.

The owner [family analysis](ring-family-symmetric-stability-2026-10-03.md) supplies the complete equation, root census, tensor derivation, controls, claim grade and falsifiers. The fixed vocabulary “exact” refers to the reference ring satisfying the equation; “growing” here refers to the formal first variation.
